title: Columbus SWAT Officer Shoots Suspect Wanted for Killing Teen Daughter
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Columbus, Ohio — On Tuesday, March 25, 2025, Columbus Police SWAT officers located and shot 33-year-old Darnell Jones, a fugitive wanted for the murder of his 13-year-old daughter, after a tense confrontation in the Victorian Village neighborhood. Body camera footage shows officers attempting to detain Jones when he refused to comply, repeatedly urging police to kill him. As Jones reached into his pocket—where a revolver was later recovered—an officer fired multiple times, striking him in the arm, leg, and torso. Officers immediately rendered aid as Jones, still conscious, expressed a desire to die. Despite his injuries, he was transported to the hospital in stable condition and now faces multiple charges, including felonious assault on a peace officer in Franklin County.

Authorities say Jones had been under surveillance after Toledo police alerted surrounding agencies of his possible whereabouts. His daughter, Kei'Mani Latigue, was found dead inside an abandoned home in Toledo, with the coroner ruling her death a homicide caused by multiple deep cuts to her neck. Jones, who had removed her from her home without consent, was identified as the last person seen with her before she vanished. Investigators have not yet disclosed why he was in possession of a walkie-talkie at the time of his arrest. The Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation is now reviewing the officer-involved shooting as the case unfolds.
